\u2022 Duration: Choose how long Do Not Disturb stays active — 5 to 60 minutes, or set a custom value. \u2022 Offset: Adjust when DND starts relative to the prayer time (-60 to +60 minutes). \u2022 Time range: Shows you the exact DND start and end time for each prayer.

Disable battery optimization for reliable prayer alerts and geofencing
To keep prayer alarms and mosque detection running reliably, please disable battery optimization for MosqueDND.
MosqueDND needs usage access to detect when battery optimizers or cleaner apps interfere with prayer alarms. This helps us prompt you to restore functionality.
Usage access not granted — some features may not work
Accurate Islamic prayer times based on your location. Supports multiple calculation methods and per-prayer alarm notifications.
Find the exact direction to the Holy Kaaba using your device\'s sensors. Works anywhere in the world.
Automatically detects nearby mosques using your location. Save mosques from the map to build your personal mosque list.
Automatically enables Do Not Disturb when you enter a mosque geofence. Stay focused on your prayers without manual toggling.

The geofence radius defines how close you need to be to a saved mosque before Do Not Disturb is automatically enabled. A smaller radius (e.g. 20 m) requires you to be very close, while a larger radius (e.g. 200 m) triggers earlier and from further away.

Determines the start time for Asr prayer. The Shafi\'i (Standard) method calculates Asr when a shadow is equal to an object\'s height, while the Hanafi method calculates it when the shadow is twice the object\'s height.
When enabled, you will receive a notification and the Adhan will play at each prayer time. You can customize which prayers trigger notifications and choose a custom Adhan audio file.
When enabled, the app will automatically enable Do Not Disturb mode when you enter a saved mosque\'s geofence area, and disable DND when you leave.
When the master alarm is off, all per-prayer alarm toggles are disabled and no Adhan alarms will fire. Toggle individual prayers back on from the Prayer Times screen.
Replay the introductory onboarding screens to learn about the app\'s features and set up permissions from scratch.

Tap the map to place a marker, then enter a name for the mosque. The geofence radius controls how close you need to be before DND activates. You can adjust the radius with the slider or use \"Detect Nearby\" to automatically find mosques from OpenStreetMap.\n\nMosques are saved locally and used to manage Do Not Disturb around prayer times.
Save your local mosques to enable automatic Do Not Disturb when you pray. MosqueDND detects when you enter a mosque geofence and silences your phone so you can focus on your prayers.

1. Tap "Add Mosque" to open the map
2. Search or browse for nearby mosques
3. Tap on a mosque to save it
4. Adjust the geofence radius if needed

Select your Islamic school of thought

Select the school of thought (madhhab) you follow. This maps to the appropriate calculation method and Asr method combination:

• Hanafi → Standard calc, Hanafi Asr
• Hanbali, Maliki, Shafi'i, Zaydi, Ibadi → Standard calc, Standard Asr
• Shia Jafari → Jafari calc, Standard Asr
• Custom → Leave both as manually set
MosqueDND uses exact alarms for precise prayer time scheduling. Please grant the Alarms and reminders permission in Settings.

MosqueDND uses background location only to detect when you are near a saved mosque and automatically enable Do Not Disturb.

• It runs only while monitoring is turned on.
• Your location is stored locally on this device.
• No location data is shared with any third party.
